summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 new 'Aufmaßprofi' DISTO features in the Bemaßungspfeil modal (/sketches/draw). ALL feature requirements PASS end-to-end in the web preview at 390x844, 768x1024 and 1024x1366. (1) Laser-Rückmeldung: after fast-typing '2.91m' (delay=5ms) the element [data-testid=laser-received-check] becomes visible inside the measurement input, positioned at right_margin=10px with vertical-center delta=1.0px (inside_h=True, inside_v=True — not overlapping the text, properly right-aligned and vertically centred); it disappears after 1.7s. Slow typing '2.91m' (delay=250ms) does NOT show the check; fast typing 'abcde' (non-measurement) does NOT show it. (2) Direkt-Übernehmen switch (testID 'arrow-auto-add-switch'): default OFF -> after a fast '2.91m' burst the modal stays open and tapping 'Add' writes the SVG arrow label '2.91m'. After clicking the switch ON: fast '3.62m' auto-closes the modal within <1s and the canvas gains exactly one arrow with label '3.62m' (element count +1, 'Elemente: 1'). Reopening the Bemaßungspfeil modal shows the switch is still ON (persisted in localStorage key aufmassprofi_arrow_auto_add='1'); fast '12.45m' auto-adds. With switch ON, slow typing '5.55m' (delay=250) keeps the modal open; in-modal numpad entry (taps 2 , 5 0 m -> value '2,50m') keeps the modal open (no auto-add). Cancel button closes the modal. Cursor-jump case with switch ON (keyboard.type('2,', delay=5); ArrowLeft; keyboard.type('90m', delay=5)) auto-closes the modal and writes SVG label '2,90m'; no red screen, no 'input.setSelection is not a function' error (previous iter-60 regression confirmed fixed via optional chaining input.setSelection?.(...)). Toggling the switch OFF again -> fast '7.77m' keeps the modal open (no auto-add). (3) Modal buttons on all three viewports: 'Cancel' label height=18px approx_lines=1; 'Add' label height=18px approx_lines=1 — single line, not clipped. numberOfLines={1} adjustsFontSizeToFit minimumFontScale={0.7} is present in /app/frontend/app/sketches/draw.tsx:8182,8191. Pure-logic BufferedTextInput tests in /app/tests/e2e/iter60_buffered_input_sequence.test.ts still print 'OK'. Note: active UI locale is English ('Cancel'/'Add'); no in-app language toggle reachable from this screen, so the exact German labels 'Abbrechen'/'Hinzufügen' were not visually rendered — but the numberOfLines/adjustsFontSizeToFit protection applies to the translated strings identically (both strings fit in the ~145px button at 14px font, verified at 390/768/1024 widths). No console errors, no React Native red screens, no deprecated packages triggered in this flow.

issues: Minor: the label 'Laser-Messwert sofort übernehmen' wraps to 2 lines at 390x844 (mobile) and 768x1024 next to the Switch (the row has flex:1 label + Switch). Readable and not clipped — no action required, but could be given numberOfLines={2} or a shorter label if a one-line look is desired.

critical_code_review_comments: BufferedTextInput.tsx:137 now uses input.setSelection?.(next.length, next.length) — the optional chain fixes the iter-60 red screen on react-native-web; on native iPad setSelection does exist as part of RN TextInput's ref API (Fabric & Paper) so the caret still moves to the end there. OK.

draw.tsx is ~9745 lines; still violates the >700 lines guideline (long-standing, not caused by this feature). Splitting the modals into separate components would also make it easy to reach them with dedicated testIDs.

success_rate.frontend: Feature acceptance: 18/18 PASS. (1) Rückmeldung: fast=check visible+positioned+disappears, slow=no check, non-measurement=no check (3/3). (2) Switch OFF default + burst keeps modal + Add writes label (3/3). Switch ON + fast adds label + modal auto-closes + element count +1 (3/3). Switch persists across modal re-open + second fast add (2/2). Switch ON + slow NO auto (1/1). Switch ON + numpad NO auto (1/1). Cursor-jump with ON -> label '2,90m' + no red screen (2/2). Switch OFF again -> no auto (1/1). (3) Button single-line Cancel+Add at 390/768/1024 (2*3=6/6).

context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the Bemaßungspfeil modal: open /sketches/draw?projectId=TEST_X on a 390x844 viewport. 1) Click text 'Ich habe die Hinweise gelesen' then 'App starten' to accept the Haftungsausschluss. 2) Click text 'Überspringen' to skip the 7-step tour. 3) Find svg text with exact content 'M' and click it to activate the Maßlinien tool. 4) Mouse-drag on the biggest svg (the canvas). Selectors: input[placeholder^='Maß eingeben'], [data-testid='arrow-auto-add-switch'], [data-testid='laser-received-check']. The Switch in react-native-web is a plain <div> with no aria-checked; verify state through localStorage key 'aufmassprofi_arrow_auto_add' ('1' = on, '0'/null = off) or by behaviour. Confirm buttons are labeled 'Cancel'/'Add' in the current English locale; the i18n keys are t('common.cancel') / t('common.add'), both have numberOfLines={1} adjustsFontSizeToFit minimumFontScale={0.7}. Pure-logic regression: `cd /app/frontend && npx tsx ../tests/e2e/iter60_buffered_input_sequence.test.ts` -> 'OK'.
rca_of_issue: No regressions. Iter-60's 'input.setSelection is not a function' red screen is confirmed resolved — BufferedTextInput.tsx:137 now uses optional chaining `input.setSelection?.(next.length, next.length)`, so react-native-web (where the method is undefined) silently no-ops while native iPad keeps the caret-at-end behaviour. All three new features behave per spec; the auto-add switch is correctly scoped to onDeviceInput so only genuine device-speed measurement bursts trigger the shortcut (slow human typing and in-modal numpad entry do not).
